Current phase only: Ordinary authorised passenger passage at Ceuta and Melilla, to initial EU-resident/Schengen-authorised traveller restoration.

date_scope_check.qualification_retained: NA002-D1: Contemporary reporting places the Moroccan land-border closure overnight March 12–13, 2020, with Tarajal closed at 06:00 on March 13. Spanish citizens leaving Morocco through Tarajal remained an initial exception. The March 13 calendar onset concerns ordinary passage and does not assert that every exception stopped simultaneously. May 17, 2022 is the first staged EU-resident/Schengen-authorised passenger restoration, observed by AP; commercial customs and the later cross-border-worker stage remain separate. Spanish local May 17 corresponds to late May 16 in Morocco. The 795-day figure is a calendar-date difference, not measured hours or unrestricted all-category closure.
